FAQ

What makes Batana Oil different from other hair oils?

Most oils are diluted or mixed with fillers. Our Batana Oil is 100% pure, hand-harvested in Honduras, and naturally rich in Vitamin E, Omega 3-6-9, and Vitamin A. That’s why it works faster and more effectively on thinning edges and scalp health.

Will it really help with thinning edges?

Yes. Batana Oil has been used for centuries to restore edges and even alopecia patches. It stimulates follicles, improves circulation, and helps fill in thinning or bald spots with consistent use.

How do I use it?

Massage a small amount into scalp and edges 3–4 times per week. Leave in overnight or at least 20 minutes before rinsing. It can also be used as a daily styling oil to seal moisture and add shine.

Is it safe for all hair types?

Absolutely. It’s suitable for natural, relaxed, chemically treated, and protective styles. Gentle, nutrient-rich, and free from parabens, silicones, or sulfates.

Will it make my hair greasy?

No - our oil absorbs quickly into the scalp and strands without leaving heavy buildup. It nourishes deeply while keeping hair soft and touchable.

How long before I see results?

Most women notice softer, shinier hair in the first 1–2 weeks. Edges and thinning areas often begin showing visible growth between 3–8 weeks of consistent use.

Can I use it on skin too?

Yes! Batana Oil is safe for skin and can be used to moisturize dry areas, improve elasticity, and protect against oxidative stress - though it’s most famous for its hair benefits.
